evidence.reason: The helper substitutes the same captured instance string for both `%i` and `%I`, but systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance name and `%I` as its unescaped form. Thus `Service=%I.service` in `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket` is scanned as `crq\x2dtick.service` instead of `crq-tick.service`, so the dependency is missed. This is an ordinary implementation defect in the existing expansion behavior; `%i` should remain unchanged while `%I` is systemd-unescaped.
